raw_response:
### Clone Agent Chat UI Repository

Source: https://docs.langchain.com/oss/python/langgraph/ui

Clone the Agent Chat UI repository from GitHub, install its dependencies, and start the development server for local customization.

```bash
git clone https://github.com/langchain-ai/agent-chat-ui.git
cd agent-chat-ui
pnpm install
pnpm dev
```

--------------------------------

### Start LangGraph Development Server

Source: https://docs.langchain.com/oss/python/langgraph/studio

Use this command to start the local development server, making your LangGraph agent accessible via API and the Studio UI.

```shell
langgraph dev
```

--------------------------------

### POST /runs/stream

Source: https://docs.langchain.com/oss/python/langgraph/local-server

Sends a message to the assistant for a threadless run and streams the response.

### Parameters
- **assistant_id** (string) - Required - The name of the assistant, as defined in langgraph.json.
- **input** (object) - Required - The input payload for the assistant.
- **stream_mode** (string) - Optional - Specifies the streaming mode for the response.

### Agent Chat UI > Connect to your agent

Source: https://docs.langchain.com/oss/python/langgraph/ui

Agent Chat UI supports connections to both local and deployed agents. Configuration involves providing your graph name (Graph ID), the agent server's endpoint (Deployment URL), and optionally a LangSmith API key. After setup, the UI automatically fetches and displays interrupted threads from your agent.
